definitions.explanation: One's own house or home, often with affection.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{家|や}が{一番|いちばん}。

notes:
{我|わ}が{家|や} means "my/our home" with a sense of affection.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {我|わ}が{家|や}に{帰|かえ}る (return home)
- {我|わ}が{家|や}が{一番|いちばん} (there's no place like home)
- {我|わ}が{家|や}の〜 (our family's ~)

GRAMMAR:
{我|わ}が is a classical possessive form. This pattern appears in set expressions:
- {我|わ}が{国|くに} (our country)
- {我|わ}が{子|こ} (my child)
- {我|わ}が{社|しゃ} (our company)

Note: {我|わ}が is literary/formal. Casual: うちの{家|いえ}, {自分|じぶん}の{家|いえ}
